text:
toni: Noticing a nasty startup storm in the bootstrap step of the new sample apps. The bootstrap logic fires N page fetches in parallel and when the auth token rotates we get a tight window of 429s + 502 token errors. Clients quickly hit their local circuit and onboarding stalls.

evelyn: Which sample and SDK version? Any quick logs?

toni: sample-java-starter, java-sdk 0.8.0. Config env: BOOT_PAGES=6, PAGE_SZ=30, MAX_THREADS=10, TOKEN_REFRESH_MARGIN=10s. Logs: 
2026-03-26T07:08:01Z INFO bootstrap:start pages=6
2026-03-26T07:08:02Z WARN http 429 route=/responses
2026-03-26T07:08:02Z INFO token:refresh kickoff
2026-03-26T07:08:03Z ERROR token refresh 502
2026-03-26T07:08:04Z ERROR client circuit open

jamal: Oof. Sounds like a combination of aggressive bootstrapping, aligned retries, and no dedupe on page fetch IDs. Is Java retry jittered?

evelyn: Parity note: java-sdk uses fixed exponential backoff (base 250ms, factor=2) with no jitter. Rust/go/python already have jitter. So alignment causes retry stampede. Also bootstrap enqueues same page id on retry so downstream sees dup work.

toni: Locally lowering BOOT_PAGES to 2 and MAX_THREADS to 2 makes onboarding succeed. But this is a terrible first-run experience. New users hit it and file bug reports.

jamal: Short-term mitigation options: 1) change sample defaults to conservative values, 2) add jitter to java retry backoff, 3) make bootstrap sequential-first-run mode, 4) add idempotency keys and skip if page-id seen.

evelyn: Also propose emitting telemetry event bootstrap.bootstorm with tags {sdk:java, pages:6, threads:10} so we can monitor. UI could show a small notice: "Bootstrapping paused due to transient auth error; retrying with reduced concurrency."

toni: I'll open a quick PR to change defaults in the java starter to BOOT_PAGES=2, MAX_THREADS=2 and add a README note: "If you see 429s during bootstrap set BOOT_PAGES=2".

jamal: I'll take the SDK parity patch for jitter—small change in RetryPolicy. We should implement full jitter and add unit tests to validate retry dispersion.

evelyn: I'll add a tiny change to the bootstrap flow to add a random micro-delay (10-200ms) between parallel fetch starts to help spread load. Also add a simple in-memory dedupe set keyed by page-id for the bootstrap run.

ci-bot: Canary release of sample-java-starter v0.2.1 scheduled at 2026-03-26T14:00Z.

sdk-bot: Created issue #924: "bootstrap: default config causes startup retrystorm; need jitter + idempotency" and assigned to jamal/evelyn.

toni: Thanks — will attach a tiny repro and the logs to the issue.

evelyn: Long-term idea: client-side adaptive backoff that reduces concurrency when auth errors spike. Might be a Redwood Optimize hook later.

jamal: Agreed. For now, parity + conservative defaults + dedupe should dramatically reduce first-run noise.
